title: Tidal Register
description: A study of horizontal time: layered bands of sea, sand and signal. The single orange rule is the moment the tide turns.

title: Solar Interval
description: Warm geometry for a room at noon. Two rectangles overlap like shadows that have agreed to keep each other company.

title: Quiet Signal
description: A field of faint vertical carriers, interrupted by one clear transmission. Made to be read from across a quiet room.

title: After Rain
description: Soft bodies in suspension after the weather has passed. The horizon is low enough to leave room for the sky.

title: Red Shift
description: Ten diagonal intervals of vermilion moving away from the viewer. A strict grid holds the drift in place.

title: Paper Moon
description: A pale circle drawn on warm paper, with two arcs that never quite meet. The blue rectangle is a door left ajar.

title: Night Garden
description: Leaves remembered rather than observed. A small moon keeps watch over a garden that exists only after dark.

title: Low Horizon
description: Ochre air, a dark ground and one circle holding the middle. An exercise in how little a landscape needs.
